prompt: We have about 40 internal apps on different databases and I need to build a data catalog plus a kamus data and decide which tables are in scope for a silver schema. Where do I start?
anti_pattern: Hand-rolling an ad-hoc per-table walkthrough in one context instead of invoking /data-catalog and fanning out one Engineer + one Analyst subagent per app.

prompt: I'm cataloging 43 source apps for the medallion silver model. Let me just spin up one big agent to inventory and conform everything in parallel.
anti_pattern: Parallelizing the conform/barrier step — producing N inconsistent silver fragments instead of one conformed source of truth. The barrier must run sequentially after all inventories return.

prompt: For the data-catalog inventory, classify all ~800 tables IN vs OUT of scope with the model.
anti_pattern: Sending every table to LLM judgment instead of running scripts/classify_prefilter.py first and only reasoning over the GREY remainder (the hybrid split).

prompt: The inventory found backup_2019 and django_session — those are obviously junk, just drop them from the catalog.
anti_pattern: Treating DROP/OUT-of-scope as final and removing tables silently instead of marking them owner-signoff-needed, keeping them in meta.table_catalog with scope=OUT for the data owners' review.

prompt: Two apps both have a 'customer' table. Have each per-app inventory agent decide whether its customer is the canonical entity.
anti_pattern: Resolving cross-app entity duplicates inside per-app Stage-1 agents, which never see the other apps. Duplicate resolution belongs to the conform barrier where all inventories are present at once.

prompt: Conform these sources into the silver layer as a star schema — build dim_customer with the customer's city and region denormalized in, and a fct_order.
anti_pattern: Building a denormalized dimensional star at silver. Silver is 3NF-normalized (separate master/transaction/reference tables, no inlined lookups); dim_/fct_ and denormalization belong to the gold layer.

prompt: One agent profiled the apps, classified scope, conformed silver, and designed the gold marts end to end. Looks done — ship it.
anti_pattern: Collapsing the three senior personas into one undifferentiated pass and skipping the review panel, so model, data-grounding, and business-fit defects go uncaught. Run the Architect/Engineer/Analyst review lenses before finalizing.
